what: Dither-quantised lighting (web/shaders/ditherlight/): GPU pass against the float64 CPU reference on G-buffers of the Salt Road scene
source: fixtures/dream.mjs renderFrame at 192 x 108; the same f32 G-buffer feeds both sides
why: A level decision is discrete. f32 against f64 can flip it only where the tone sits within rounding of a threshold, or where a world anchor sits within rounding of a cell edge or the dominant-axis switch. A flip changes one pixel by a whole level step, so the bounds are fractions of pixels, not code values.
